derivation:
1758. Target-dependent physical reference fields: full joint Haar transport, explicit gauge connection, and the failure of target elimination at the matched minimum. This addresses the specific unresolved target-dependence issue of1757, not a repeat of its fixed-reference elimination or another norm lemma.

KEEP THE ORIGINAL DATA. Use the same original fine torus, compact matrix Lie group G, raw fine exterior F with its fixed V0, original physical averaging definition M_fix, original action, ordinary weights, marked words and original cutoff law. Fix the original varied ACTIVE coarse row set I of the first-step problem (the source (1.12) varies the rows inside Omega1^(1)); hold the remaining original targets as original data. Write v in G^I and M_I for the projection of the UNCHANGED physical mean onto those rows. This is a parameter slice for computing the active target derivative, not permission to discard any other original coarse constraint, gauge factor, outside row or normalizer. The exterior coarse rows cannot in general be varied freely with fine V0 fixed. No new row set is selected to evade that fact.

Assume a C1 real/unitary family U0(v) on an open set O of these active targets, with U0(v)|F=V0 and M_I(U0(v))=v. In the intended application U0 is the actual target-dependent minimum U1(Omega1,V), with the same prescribed fine data and original chosen mean. Source CMP119 p.248 (1.12) states these defining constraints; this input does NOT prove a uniformly admitted C1 physical family, its domain/collars, P1, or matching to every original cutoff configuration. The following obstruction applies to ANY such admitted smooth family; it is not an invented substitute minimum or a theorem that the actual physical family has been established. Original target-dependent domains D(v) stay as their full pullbacks and may not be replaced by a fixed box in the new group variables. Additional singular constraints require their already admitted measure interpretation and are transported intact.

Use one SAME compatible auxiliary native comb forest T and roots R throughout O. At each v define P_rz(v)=U0(v)(Gamma_rz). For T_F=T intersect F, let A be the nonroot component-top sites and kappa their residual group coordinates. For each e=(p,z) in T_F, define k(z)=U0_e(v)^(-1)k(p)V0_e, with root values I and top values kappa. Because U0_e(v)=V0_e on F, this particular recursion is independent of v. Call it K(kappa); every k is fixed when differentiating v at fixed kappa. This simplification would be false for a reference family not matching the original fine exterior.

On the admitted common local group/log domain set Z_z=Log k(z), X_z(v)=Ad_(P_rz(v)) Z_z, A_r(v,k)=sum_z L^-d X_z, a_r=exp A_r, g_r=a_r^-1, l_g(z)=P_rz^-1 g_r P_rz, u=l_g k. All logarithms are smooth, Lie(G)-valued and conjugation covariant on the SAME original branch, so Log(Ad_P k)=Ad_P Log k. No merely spectral matrix branch is substituted for a Lie-group chart. The joint domain may be any open subset where these conditions hold; no global uniform chart cover or nonzero chart mass is asserted.

RECENTER ONLY THE AUXILIARY FREE GROUP COORDINATES. For every non-tree link not in F use a residual group variable w_b and put Y_b=w_b U0_b(v). For e in T put Y_e=U0_e(v). For b in F minus T put Y_b=u(b_-)V0_b u(b_+)^-1. Define q=(kappa,w) and

 U=Psi_v(q)=Y(q,v)^(u(v,K(kappa))^-1).

This is the1757 fixed-fine-data chart at each v, followed only by right translation of the free non-tree Y links. No coarse constraint has been solved, no old mean replaces M_fix, no source pivot is removed twice, and no Lie-algebra measure is declared flat. The point q0=(all kappa=I, all w=I) is independent of v. At q0, K=I, Z=X=A=0, g=u=I, Y=U0(v), and Psi_v(q0)=U0(v). This includes F=E only if a nontrivial active family is possible; if fine data fix every field, such a family cannot vary an independent nonempty I.

At every fixed v, the direct fine-fiber triangular argument gives dU_(E minus F)=dq, where dq is normalized product Haar of kappa and w. Hence the FULL JOINT change (q,v)->(Psi_v(q),v) has product Haar Jacobian1: its v coordinate is unchanged, and the off-diagonal v dependence of Psi does not alter that block-triangular measure statement. More directly, apply the fixed-v change inside a joint integral and Fubini on its actual integrable support. The original joint domain is pulled back exactly. This is not a final Landau/FP determinant and does not set any later coarse-pivot determinant to1.

The original active coarse graph measure, before weighting with the unchanged factors, is dU_active dv delta_G^I(M_I(U)v^-1), at fixed fine data. As usual this notation means its canonical weak graph measure, not a density on every coarse fiber. The full joint diffeomorphism transports it into

 dq dv delta_G^I(H(q,v)),  H(q,v)=M_I(Psi_v(q)) v^-1,

with its meaning defined by that joint pullback, all original factors and all other original constraints still retained. For a fully explicit chart argument, the original active residual is a submersion in its independent v variable; the joint map is a diffeomorphism, so its pulled-back group delta is well defined locally. The unit full joint Haar Jacobian is the only measure factor from this change. This does not imply that v->H(q,v) is a submersion at fixed q, nor that the transformed measure is a graph over q. If extra original singular constraints are present, their joint product is not newly justified by this active-residual argument.

Pointwise gauge equivariance gives M_I(Psi_v(q))(c)=u(c_-)^-1 M_I(Y)(c)u(c_+). Let v^u(c)=u(c_-)v(c)u(c_+)^-1 at the ACTUAL endpoints. Then

 H_c=u(c_-)^-1 [M_I(Y)(c)(v^u(c))^-1] u(c_-).

Thus the conjugated residual is still the correct transport. However u now depends on v. It is invalid to justify integration over v at fixed q merely by calling v->v^u a fixed left/right Haar translation. No such independence is present. The equality of group deltas can instead be justified on the full joint submersion: at residual identity, the derivative of the variable conjugation is Ad_(u_-^-1), whose Haar determinant is1; terms differentiating the conjugator vanish at residual identity. No new numerical factor is obtained by pretending u is constant in v.

EXPLICIT TARGET DERIVATIVE OF THE COORDINATE MAP. Use LEFT logarithmic velocities: xi_c=dot v_c v_c^-1, rho_b=dot U0_b U0_b^-1, p_z=dot P_rz P_rz^-1, gamma_r=dot g_r g_r^-1, alpha_z=dot u(z)u(z)^-1, y_b=dot Y_b Y_b^-1, all at fixed q. Since U0|F=V0, rho_b=0 on F. For a canonical oriented path, p_z is the ordered sum of Ad_(background prefix) rho_e; a reversed appearance contributes rho_(e^-1)=-Ad_(U0_e^-1)rho_e.

Since k is fixed and Log is conjugation covariant, dot X_z=[p_z,X_z], and dot A_r=sum_z L^-d [p_z,X_z]. With dexp_A(B)=integral_0^1 Ad_(exp(t A)) B dt, differentiating the matrix exponential and g=a^-1 gives

 gamma_r=-Ad_(g_r) dexp_(A_r)(dot A_r),
 alpha_z=Ad_(P_rz^-1) [gamma_r+(Ad_(g_r)-I)p_z].

These are actual derivatives of the explicit averaged gauge, not a new unspecified connection estimate. At fixed q,

 y_e=rho_e on T;
 y_b=Ad_(w_b)rho_b on non-tree links outside F;
 y_b=alpha_(b_-)-Ad_(Y_b)alpha_(b_+) on F minus T.

Consequently the actual left-trivialized background-target derivative W=D_v Psi_v at fixed q is

 (W xi)_b=Ad_(u(b_-)^-1)[y_b-alpha_(b_-)+Ad_(Y_b)alpha_(b_+)].

On F this is zero, as also follows directly from Psi_v(q)|F=V0. On tree links in F, rho=0 and the two alpha terms cancel because differentiating l_g(p)U0_e l_g(z)^-1=U0_e gives alpha_p=Ad_(U0_e)alpha_z. All other target-dependent gauge, path and background terms remain present; no locality/decay or uniform derivative bound is claimed by writing them explicitly. At q0, all X,A,g-I and alpha vanish, w=I, Y=U0, and W(q0,v) xi=rho=D_v U0(v)xi.

ACTUAL ACTIVE TARGET BLOCK. Let P_U be the left-trivialized derivative of the same M_I at U: it maps z_b=dot U_b U_b^-1 to dot M_c M_c^-1. At a constraint point M_I(Psi_v(q))=v, the left residual derivative at fixed q is

 D_v H(q,v) xi = (P_U W(q,v)-I) xi.

This formula includes the derivative of the reference family and gauge frame. In the conjugated residual the corresponding derivative is conjugated by the actual root/end-point Ad matrices; on the residual locus these have Haar determinant1. Define N=I-P_U W. If, at a fixed q, all roots of H(q,v)=I under consideration are isolated regular roots with N invertible, then integrating that group delta in v has the local change-of-variables factors |det N|^-1, summed over those roots, with the original Haar normalization and support. This is only the REGULAR TARGET-ELIMINATION formula. It is NOT an extra factor to insert into the full joint Haar change or a claim that N is invertible.

MATCHED PHYSICAL CENTER: THE TARGET BLOCK VANISHES. The actual defining identity M_I(U0(v))=v and q0 fixed imply H(q0,v)=I for every v in O. Differentiating gives

 P_(U0(v)) D_v U0(v)=I,
 W(q0,v)=D_v U0(v),
 N(q0,v)=0.

For a nonempty active target set and a positive-dimensional G, this target block is singular. Thus no route that needs a uniformly nonzero target-elimination determinant on a domain containing q0 can be justified by a smallness assumption: the zero is exact at the matched center. No claim of physical sector realization is made when the smooth family or q0's membership in the actual physical domain is unadmitted. Conditionally on the actual admitted minimum family and its center, the obstruction follows from its unchanged defining constraint alone.

This is NOT failure of the original graph measure, source theorem, physical minimum, fine-exterior elimination or full joint Jacobian. D_q Psi_v is an isomorphism of all active raw fine tangent variables, and D_v U0 is tangent to the fixed-fine-data space. The identity P D_v U0=I implies P is onto, so D_q H=P D_q Psi_v is onto at q0. The full active residual remains a submersion even though its v block is zero. Some q minor can therefore serve as local pivot coordinates in the finite-dimensional inverse-function sense. This DOES NOT identify that minor with the source's actual chosen b0(c), its scalar metrics/scales or its determinant, and does not admit the unchanged K_C free-algebra cutoff. The source itself solves constraints in fluctuation/pivot variables in CMP119 p.249, rather than using a regular target derivative at the matched center. The proposed shortcut of regular target integration should be abandoned, not renamed as a new physical hypothesis.

EXACT COMPACT-GROUP SANITY COUNTERTEST (NOT THE PHYSICAL LATTICE). On one group variable, take M(U)=U, U0(v)=v and U=w v, with no fine exterior. Product Haar is dU dv=dw dv, while M(U)v^-1=w. The original canonical graph measure becomes delta_G(w)dw dv. At w=I every v is a root; D_v H=0 and N=0. The kernel at any fixed v is still the well-defined evaluation f(v;v). Treating the delta as a regular delta in v would be invalid. This example has no native physical L>11 blocks, no original torus/sector, no K_C and no claimed source theorem counterexample; it illustrates the same target-block mechanism analytically without numerical extrapolation.

MARKS, DENSITIES AND LIMITS. Full words and original noninvariant weights remain pulled back. At fixed original matrix source J, its moving source J'=u J u^-1 has target derivative dot J'=[alpha,J']; if J itself depends on v add Ad_u(dot J). This is only the source-frame contribution: derivatives of Y, U0, original factors, domains and entire words also remain. At q0 the frame contribution alpha vanishes; that does not remove off-center or mixed derivatives. Crossing words are not split, wholly fine-prescribed words still equal their original ordered V0 word once, and open words retain both endpoint factors. Finite complex polynomial sources are handled coefficientwise under original integrability, with no positivity or log-connected inference.

The full off-chart part and all original exterior/coarse constraints and normalization factors remain. No nonzero denominator, uniform profile, source190/Hsharp operator identification, source pivots/Jacobian, native multiscale B dictionary, P1 repair, simultaneous parameter chain, connected sum or history is established. The new result is explicit target-dependent joint transport and gauge-connection differentiation, together with the exact matched-center obstruction to regular target elimination. Falsifiers include a reversed dexp/adjoint sign, missing v derivative or fixed-exterior contribution, an incorrect residual derivative, varying exterior rows freely, inserting |det N|^-1 without regular roots, or silently exchanging the original physical mean/domain/background family.
